verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents opt-out from the Model Improvement Program per request (mip_opt_out=true), with opted-out requests not retained, and offers regional endpoints (EU/AU/India) for data residency needs, giving users some control over retention. However, there's no evidence of a broader self-service deletion mechanism, granular retention policy controls, or detailed data lifecycle/export tools beyond the MIP opt-out flag. Missing for 10: documented data deletion API/workflow, configurable retention windows, and independent confirmation of opt-out enforcement.
